facts.key: bird species seen in local park

plans.text: Improve bird photography skills, especially close-up shots of skittish birds such as Northern Flickers.
Improve bird identification skills, especially distinguishing warblers and sparrows.
Explore more birding spots in the user's area and see what other species can be spotted.
Take a trip to a nearby lake next weekend and spot waterbirds.
Bring binoculars and a spotting scope to the nearby lake next weekend and get a closer look for Ospreys and Bald Eagles.
Have a picnic in the local park this weekend and bring bird-friendly food to attract recently seen birds.
Bring sunflower seeds and suet to the local park to attract woodpeckers.
Bring some water and a birdbath to attract more birds.
Bring fresh fruits like apples and oranges to the local park to attract birds.
Bring peanut butter to the local park to attract woodpeckers and nuthatches.
Bring binoculars to get a closer look at the birds and look for warblers and sparrows.
